versos.texto_bv: Naquele dia, não haverá luz; as coisas preciosas se congelarão.
versos.traducao_literal: E será, no dia aquele: não haverá luz; preciosas, elas se congelarão.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): As 3 referências divergem substancialmente do sentido da BV para este versículo, provavelmente por leitura textual distinta de uma crux hebraica conhecida (יְקָרוֹת יִקָפָאוּן). — evidência: BV: “não haverá luz; as coisas preciosas se congelarão” × NTLH: “não fará mais frio, nem haverá geada” × ARA: “não haverá calor, nem frio, nem geada” × NVIPT: “não haverá calor nem frio”. Alinhar a BV a qualquer uma das referências exigiria adotar uma leitura/emenda diferente do substrato hebraico — mudança de sentido, fora da autoridade de forma desta revisão.

kjv.texto: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the light shall not be clear, nor dark:

vizinhos.5: And ye shall flee to the valley of the mountains; for the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azal: yea, ye shall flee, like as ye fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah: and the Lord my God shall come, and all the saints with thee.
vizinhos.7: But it shall be one day which shall be known to the Lord, not day, nor night: but it shall come to pass, that at evening time it shall be light.

web.texto: It will happen in that day, that there will not be light, cold, or frost.

vizinhos.5: You shall flee by the valley of my mountains; for the valley of the mountains shall reach to Azel; yes, you shall flee, just like you fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. Yahweh my God will come, and all the holy ones with you./f + Septuagint reads “him” instead of “you”./f*
vizinhos.7: It will be a unique day which is known to Yahweh; not day, and not night; but it will come to pass, that at evening time there will be light.
